note: Strummed rock and pop additions towards ~100 songs (28 Oct 2026), from docs/STRUMALONG_SONG_RESEARCH.md (v4 batch). Each entry carries genre (rock or pop). Capo, setup and skill notes are authored suggestions from chord sheets; practice patterns come from the level defaults. Not checked against the recordings beyond the automatic chart sanity check.

songs.title: Hold My Hand
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play A, D and E shapes; they sound as B, E and F#.
songs.skill_focus: Mostly A to D with E in the chorus, on a steady band strum. Keep the strum loose and change on the bar.

sources.title: Hold My Hand chords (zachmanson mirror of Ultimate Guitar)

songs.title: Lookin' Out My Back Door
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: play G, Em, C and D shapes; they sound as B, G#m, E and F#.
songs.skill_focus: A bouncy country-rock strum on four open shapes. Keep the eighths steady and land the changes on the beat.

sources.title: Hooktheory TheoryTab: Lookin' Out My Back Door

songs.title: End of the Line
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open D, A and G shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A train-beat acoustic strum on D, A and G. Fast, so start slow and keep the right hand moving.

sources.title: Lauren Bateman: End of the Line chords

songs.title: Rockin' in the Free World
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open Em, D, C and G shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A loud electric strum on Em, D and C. Keep the eighths driving and hit the changes together with the drums.

sources.title: SongBPM: Rockin' in the Free World

songs.title: 3AM
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 1 suggested: play G, Cadd9, D and Em shapes; they sound as Ab, Dbadd9, Eb and Fm.
songs.skill_focus: Four open shapes on a steady acoustic strum. Cadd9 and G share fingers, so keep the third and fourth fingers anchored.

songs.title: Only Wanna Be with You
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: play D, G, A and Em shapes; they sound as F#, B, C# and G#m.
songs.skill_focus: A jangly capo strum on D, G, A and Em. Some changes come mid-bar, so count the half-bar moves.

sources.title: Only Wanna Be with You chords (zachmanson mirror)
Guitar Player: the capo story behind the song

songs.title: Last Kiss
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open G, Em, C and D shapes.
songs.skill_focus: The doo-wop G-Em-C-D loop with a shuffle feel. Swing the eighths and keep each chord for a bar.

songs.title: Small Town
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: play G, Dsus2, Cadd9 and Am shapes; they sound as B, F#sus2, Eadd9 and C#m.
songs.skill_focus: A driving heartland strum on capo-4 open shapes. Keep the eighths even and ring out the sus chords.

songs.title: What I Got
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open D and G shapes.
songs.skill_focus: Two chords, D and G, on a relaxed acoustic strum over a hip-hop beat. A good first two-chord groove.

sources.title: Ultimate Guitar What I Got chords

songs.title: Laid
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 5 suggested: play G, C and D shapes; they sound as C, F and G.
songs.skill_focus: A frantic acoustic strum on G, C and D shapes. Fast and short: build speed in stages.

songs.title: Lightning Bolt
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play D, A and G shapes; they sound as E, B and A.
songs.skill_focus: A fast train-beat acoustic strum on D, A and G. Keep the right hand moving and change without stopping.

songs.title: Dead Flowers
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open D, G and A shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A country acoustic strum on D, G and A. Watch the phrase that runs into the chorus.

sources.title: School of Feedback: Dead Flowers lesson

songs.title: Rockin' All Over the World
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 5 suggested: play G, C and D shapes; they sound as C, F and G.
songs.skill_focus: A rock strum on G, C and D shapes with a boogie push. Keep the eighths tight with the drums.

sources.title: guitartabs.cc Rockin' All Over the World chords
SongBPM: Rockin' All Over the World

songs.title: You Belong with Me
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: play D, A, G and Em shapes; they sound as F#, C#, B and G#m.
songs.skill_focus: Steady down-up eighths on four capo shapes; banjo colours the record, but the acoustic strum drives it.

sources.title: Ultimate Guitar You Belong with Me chords

songs.title: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open Cadd9, G, D and Em shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A four-chord loop with muted chops on the backbeat. Start with plain eighths, then add the chop.

sources.title: Ultimate Guitar We Are Never Ever chords
SongBPM: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together

songs.title: Margaritaville
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open D, A and G shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A relaxed acoustic strum on D, A and G. Long holds: keep the strum easy and even.

songs.title: Every Morning
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 1 suggested: play G, D and C shapes; they sound as Ab, Eb and Db.
songs.skill_focus: A three-chord acoustic loop with a light Latin bounce. Keep the strum relaxed and steady.

songs.title: Stubborn Love
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 5 suggested: play C, Em, G and D shapes; they sound as F, Am, C and G.
songs.skill_focus: An acoustic strum that builds with the band and cello. Hold the tempo when it gets louder.

songs.title: You're Still the One
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 1 suggested: play D, G, A and Em shapes; they sound as Eb, Ab, Bb and Fm.
songs.skill_focus: A slow acoustic strum on four open shapes. Let the chords ring and keep the slow pulse steady.

sources.title: Totally Guitars: You're Still the One lesson
guitartabs.cc You're Still the One chords

songs.title: Stick Season
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play G, D, Em and C shapes; they sound as A, E, F#m and D.
songs.skill_focus: Four open shapes on a fast, driving strum. The first verse is picked on the record; strum along from the first chorus.

songs.title: Cat's in the Cradle
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 1 suggested: play E, D, G and A shapes; they sound as F, Eb, Ab and Bb.
songs.skill_focus: A strummed 12-string verse and chorus after a picked intro.

songs.title: If I Had $1000000
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play G, D, C and Em shapes; they sound as A, E, D and F#m.
songs.skill_focus: A bright acoustic strum on four open shapes.

sources.title: Ultimate Guitar If I Had $1000000 chords

songs.title: Follow Me
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 3 suggested: play D, G, A and Em shapes; they sound as F, Bb, C and Gm.
songs.skill_focus: A relaxed acoustic strum on D, G and A, with Em in the bridge. Keep the strum light and even.

songs.title: Mine
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open C, G, D and Em shapes.
songs.skill_focus: Four open shapes on a bright acoustic strum, with banjo on top. Keep the eighths steady through the build.

songs.title: Songbird
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open G and Em7 shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A short acoustic strum on G and Em7 with an F# bass passing note. Check the instrumental bar counts.

songs.title: Hanging by a Moment
songs.setup_note: Capo 6 suggested in standard tuning (EADGBE): play G, D, Em and C shapes; they sound as Db, Ab, Bbm and Gb. The record is tuned down (drop D a half step lower), so capo 6 matches its pitch without retuning.
songs.skill_focus: Driving eighth-note strumming on G, D, Em and C shapes. Keep the right hand constant through the chorus.

sources.title: Hooktheory TheoryTab: Hanging by a Moment
guitartabs.cc Hanging by a Moment chords

songs.title: Who'll Stop the Rain
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open G, C, D, Em and Am shapes.
songs.skill_focus: Five open shapes on a steady acoustic strum. Some charts add Bm; play D in its place if it is too quick.

sources.title: Lauren Bateman: Who'll Stop the Rain chords
Classic Song of the Day: Who'll Stop the Rain

songs.title: Have a Nice Day
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play A, G, D, E and D/F# shapes; they sound as B, A, E, F# and E/G#.
songs.skill_focus: A bright acoustic strum through several open shapes with sus colours. Practise the A to G to D moves.

sources.title: Andy Guitar: Have a Nice Day lesson
guitartabs.cc Have a Nice Day chords

songs.title: Accidentally in Love
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open G, Em, C, D, A and Am shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A bright, quick strum through six open shapes. Keep the eighths light and pre-plan the A and Am changes.

songs.title: Home
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 5 suggested: play G, C, Em, D and D/F# shapes; they sound as C, F, Am, G and G/B.
songs.skill_focus: An acoustic strum with a D/F# walk-down into Em. Practise the walk-down slowly first.

songs.title: Me and Julio Down by the Schoolyard
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D, E, B7 and G shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A percussive, syncopated acoustic strum with cut-off accents. Learn the chords on plain eighths, then add the accents.

sources.title: Lauren Bateman: Me and Julio chords

songs.title: Rude
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 6 suggested: play G, C, D and Em shapes; they sound as Db, Gb, Ab and Bbm.
songs.skill_focus: Reggae off-beat chops on four open shapes. Mute between the chops and keep the beat in your foot.

songs.title: One Headlight
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 7 suggested: play G, C, B7, Em and D shapes; they sound as D, G, F#7, Bm and A.
songs.skill_focus: An acoustic strum under organ and slide. Five shapes including B7; practise the Em to B7 move.
